auth.subSignin: Sign in to continue to ONEROUTE
auth.subSignup: Sign up to start or join a convoy
auth.invite: You’re invited to trip {{code}}. Sign in or create an account to join.
auth.name: Your name
auth.remember: Keep me signed in on this device
auth.consent: I’m 18 or older and I agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> (opens in a new tab).
auth.note: You only need to do this once on each device.

err.name: Enter your name.
err.passwordShort: Use a password with at least 8 characters.
err.consent: Please tick the box to agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy.
err.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection.
err.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
err.serverSlow: The server is not responding. Check your connection.
err.googleConsent: Almost done{{name}}: tick the box to agree to the Terms and Privacy Policy, then press “Agree and continue with Google”.
err.imageBig: That photo is too large (15 MB max).
err.photoSave: Account created, but the photo was not saved: {{reason}}

server.email_exists: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in.
server.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
server.google_unverified: Google sign-in could not be verified. Try again.
server.google_wrong_account: This email belongs to a different Google account.
server.google_not_configured: Google sign-in is not set up on this server.
server.login_failed: Could not sign in. Try again.
server.signup_failed: Could not create the account. Try again.
server.password_long: That password is too long (128 characters max).

install.title: Install ONEROUTE
install.body: Add it to your home screen for quick access and a full-screen view.
install.iosHint: On iPhone: tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.

update.title: A new version is ready
update.body: Update when it suits you. We won’t reload while you’re driving.

offline.title: You’re offline
offline.body: Live convoy updates will continue when your connection returns.

driving.title: Driving mode
driving.tip: Keep your eyes on the road. Send a voice message instead of typing.

nav.endOfRoad: At the end of the road, turn {{dir}}

spoken.arrive: you will arrive at your destination
spoken.roundaboutExit: take the {{ord}} exit at the roundabout
spoken.endOfRoad: turn {{dir}} at the end of the road
spoken.missed: You have missed your turn. Finding a route to rejoin.

help.denied: Location is blocked for this site. Click the lock icon next to the web address, set Location to Allow, then reload.
help.prompt: Your browser is waiting for your permission. Look for the location prompt near the address bar and choose Allow.
help.unavailable: Your device isn't sharing a location. On Windows open Settings → Privacy & security → Location and turn on Location services. On a phone, turn on Location and Wi-Fi.
help.insecure: Location only works on a secure (https) address. Open the https link instead.

gps.manual: Set my location on the map
gps.tapMap: Tap the map where you are
gps.tapMapBody: Your convoy will see you here until GPS works.
gps.approxBody: No GPS chip found, so ONEROUTE is using Wi-Fi location. It can be off by a few hundred metres.

turn.preview: Preview from the trip start. Live directions begin when your location is found.

start.label: Starting point
start.hint: Leave empty to start from where you are now.
start.pick: Pick your starting point from the results, or clear the box to start from where you are.
start.none: No places found. Try a more specific name.
start.failed: Search failed. Check your internet connection.
